questions.question: It was only when I had finished the task that I realized I had forgotten my lunch.
options: I had forgotten my lunch because it was only when I had finished the task.
Only after finishing the task did I realize I had forgotten my lunch.
I forgot my lunch, which was only when I finished the task.
It wasn't until I'd completed the task that I remembered my lunch.
questions.answer: Only after finishing the task did I realize I had forgotten my lunch.

questions.question: By the time she arrived, we had been waiting for over an hour.
options: When she arrived, it was more than an hour that we had been waiting.
We had been waiting for over an hour by the time she arrived.
It was already over an hour when she finally arrived and we were still waiting.
She had only just arrived, but we'd been waiting for well over an hour.
questions.answer: We had been waiting for over an hour by the time she arrived.

questions.question: I would have gone to the party if I hadn't received your message.
options: If I hadn't received your message, I wouldn't have gone to the party.
It was only because of your message that I didn't go to the party.
Had it not been for your message, I would have definitely attended the party.
Your message stopped me from going to the party.
questions.answer: If I hadn't received your message, I wouldn't have gone to the party.

questions.question: The company will not be able to function without its CEO.
options: It is only when the company's CEO leaves that it will cease to function.
Unless the company gets a new CEO, it won't be able to continue operating.
Even if the CEO were to leave tomorrow, the company would still manage to keep running.
The company can certainly carry on without its CEO.
questions.answer: Unless the company gets a new CEO, it won't be able to continue operating.

questions.question: It is essential that all employees are aware of the new policy.
options: All employees should know about the new policy.
The new policy must be communicated clearly to everyone in the company.
In order for the new policy to be effective, it's crucial that staff are informed.
Employees need to be told about the new policy.
questions.answer: In order for the new policy to be effective, it's crucial that staff are informed.
